name: Learn: Assemble a Hardened Deployment (capstone)
objective: Capstone practical: assemble ONE Deployment that satisfies ~10 interlocking production requirements — config + secret injection, emptyDir, full securityContext hardening, exact resources, a probe, a dedicated SA, and its Service. Graded strictly, per requirement, with the exact reason for anything you miss. This is the 'put it all together' skill the exam tests and most practice skips.
description: A single composite object with 10 exactly-graded requirements. Build it from the brief; the Check panel shows which requirements you nailed and which you missed, with reasons.

questions.title: Build the hardened 'checkout' Deployment + Service (read the whole brief first)
questions.teach:
This is a capstone: one Deployment + Service that must satisfy ~10 interlocking requirements at once — identity, config, storage, security, resources, health, exposure. The skill is assembling it from a dense brief without missing a field. Scaffold with `kubectl create deployment … --dry-run=client -o yaml`, then hand-edit the hard parts.

**Gotcha:** every value is graded **exactly** — a missing `tier=api` label, UID `1000` instead of `1001`, `cpu: 200m` instead of `100m`, or `targetPort: 8080` instead of `80` each loses marks. Check field-by-field against the brief before you submit.
questions.prompt:
The payments team needs their **checkout API** deployed to the **`shop`** namespace. The namespace already contains a ConfigMap `checkout-cfg`, a Secret `checkout-sec`, and a ServiceAccount `checkout-sa` — **wire them in; do not recreate them**.

Create a Deployment **`checkout`** meeting ALL of the following, then expose it. Every bullet is graded exactly.

- **3** replicas; image **`nginx:1.27-alpine`**; container named **`api`** (exactly one container).
- Pod template labelled **`app=checkout`** AND **`tier=api`**; selector matches `app=checkout`.
- Run under ServiceAccount **`checkout-sa`** (not `default`).
- **Bulk-inject** every key of ConfigMap `checkout-cfg` as env; **and** set env **`API_KEY`** from the `API_KEY` key of Secret `checkout-sec`.
- Mount an **`emptyDir`** at **`/var/cache/checkout`**.
- Container security: **read-only root filesystem**, run as **non-root** with **UID 1001**, **drop ALL** capabilities.
- Resources: requests **cpu=100m, memory=128Mi**; limits **cpu=250m, memory=256Mi**.
- Readiness probe: **HTTP GET `/` on port 80**, `initialDelaySeconds=5`, `periodSeconds=10`.
- Expose with a **ClusterIP** Service **`checkout`** on port **8080** → container port **80**.

All in namespace `shop`. (Grading checks the object spec, not whether the read-only pod starts.)
questions.hint: Scaffold, then harden: `kubectl -n shop create deployment checkout --image=nginx:1.27-alpine --replicas=3 --dry-run=client -o yaml > d.yaml`, then edit in: the container name `api`, `serviceAccountName`, `envFrom`+`env`, the `emptyDir` volume+mount, `securityContext` (readOnlyRootFilesystem/runAsNonRoot/runAsUser 1001/capabilities drop ALL), `resources`, `readinessProbe`, and the `tier=api` label. Then `kubectl -n shop expose deployment checkout --name checkout --port 8080 --target-port 80` (verify it's ClusterIP). Check your work field-by-field against the brief before you Check.
questions.solution:
cat <<'YAML' | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata: { name: checkout, namespace: shop }
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector: { matchLabels: { app: checkout } }
  template:
    metadata: { labels: { app: checkout, tier: api } }
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: checkout-sa
      containers:
      - name: api
        image: nginx:1.27-alpine
        envFrom: [ { configMapRef: { name: checkout-cfg } } ]
        env:
        - name: API_KEY
          valueFrom: { secretKeyRef: { name: checkout-sec, key: API_KEY } }
        volumeMounts: [ { name: cache, mountPath: /var/cache/checkout } ]
        securityContext:
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1001
          capabilities: { drop: ["ALL"] }
        resources:
          requests: { cpu: 100m, memory: 128Mi }
          limits: { cpu: 250m, memory: 256Mi }
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet: { path: /, port: 80 }
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 10
      volumes: [ { name: cache, emptyDir: {} } ]
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata: { name: checkout, namespace: shop }
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector: { app: checkout }
  ports: [ { port: 8080, targetPort: 80 } ]
YAML

verification.description: Deployment checkout: 3 replicas, one container 'api' on image nginx:1.27-alpine
Pod labels app=checkout + tier=api; selector app=checkout
env API_KEY from Secret checkout-sec key API_KEY
securityContext: readOnlyRootFilesystem, runAsNonRoot, UID 1001, drop ALL caps
Service checkout: ClusterIP 8080 -> targetPort 80, selector app=checkout
